manifest.name: Git repository
manifest.description: Keeps a version history of your projects as you write, and can back it up to your own git repository (on GitHub, GitLab, Forgejo or your own server) over https, with a user name and an access token. You can also open a project from the repository on another device. It needs no other program. For people who keep their work in git.

permissions.project:folder: keep a version history in your project’s folder, back it up to the git repository you choose, and open projects from it

messages.settings.shared.label: Repository for your books
messages.settings.shared.description: The repository’s https address. Each project gets its own branch there.
messages.settings.user.label: User name
messages.settings.user.description: Your user name on the server.
messages.settings.token.label: Access token
messages.settings.token.description: An access token from the server, with the right to write to the repository. It’s kept sealed on this device.
messages.command.now: Back up to your repository now
messages.command.book: Use a separate repository for this book…
messages.command.none: Keep this book’s history on this device only
messages.command.open: Open a book from a repository…
messages.book.title: Separate repository for this book
messages.book.label: Repository address. Leave it empty to use the one for all your books.
messages.none.done: This book’s history will stay on this device and won’t be backed up to a repository.
messages.open.title: Open a book from a repository
messages.open.label: Repository address
messages.open.empty: There are no books in that repository.
messages.open.failed: Couldn’t get the book from the repository.
messages.open.failedBecause: Couldn’t get the book from the repository: {message}
messages.now.noRepository: Choose a repository in this plugin’s settings first.
messages.status.failedBecause: The last backup to your repository failed: {message}
messages.failed.push: Couldn’t send the versions to your repository: {message}
messages.failed.nothingToPush: There is no history to push yet.
messages.failed.refused: Bläck Studio wasn’t allowed to send the history to {url}
messages.failed.signIn: The repository didn’t accept your sign-in. Check the user name and access token in this plugin’s settings.
messages.failed.notFound: There’s no repository at that address.
messages.failed.notAFolder: This project’s .git isn’t a folder, so Bläck Studio won’t use it.
messages.address.ssh: This plugin can’t use an SSH address. Enter the repository’s https address instead, and sign in with a user name and an access token.
messages.address.http: The address must start with https://, because your access token would otherwise be sent unencrypted.
messages.address.login: Leave the user name and token out of the address, and enter them in this plugin’s settings.
messages.address.other: That isn’t a repository’s https address: {url}
messages.conflicts.one: A document was changed both here and on another device. The text from this device is kept, and the other version is in its history.
messages.conflicts.other: {count} documents were changed both here and on another device. The text from this device is kept, and the other versions are in their history.
